basic_profile.bio: A 25-year-old hobbyist living in Austin, Texas, who recently discovered the joys of crafting and DIY projects. Passionate about learning new skills, especially in the realm of Internet of Things (IoT) and technology. Works as a junior software developer by day and enjoys spending weekends exploring local craft fairs and farmers' markets with their partner. Typically online in the evenings and often during lunch breaks. In a committed relationship and enjoys connecting with like-minded individuals online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Has a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and has been delving into IoT through online courses and hands-on projects. Enjoys crafting as a relaxing hobby and learns through YouTube tutorials and crafting blogs.
